pages.title: Quantum Ore
pages.text: Explore the Overworld below Y=16 where stone is still common. Quantum Ore can glow when you touch or strike it.

pages.title: Deepslate Ore
pages.text: Look in deep Overworld deepslate, especially near the bottom of the world. The deepest veins tend to be near Y=-64.
Use an iron, diamond, or netherite pickaxe. Both ores drop $(l:qcraft:basics/dust)Quantum Dust$(/l). Fortune can increase the drop. With Silk Touch, the pickaxe recovers the ore itself.
